content: संचर् €1 <ab>P.</ab> (but <ab>Ātm.</ab> when used with the instrumental of a conveyance) .²1 To move, walk, go, pass, walk about; यानैः समचरन्तान्ये <ls>Bk. 8. 32</ls>; क्वचित् पथा संचरते सुराणाम् <ls>R. 13. 19</ls>; <ls>N. 6. 57</ls>. .²2 To practise, perform. .²3 To pass over, be transferred to. .²4 To act, behave; भो राजानश्चरमवयसामाज्ञया संचरध्वम् <ls>Māl. 6. 2</ls>. .²5 To join, meet. .²6 To pass or roam through, travel over. .²7 To arrive at, reach, attain. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} .²1 To cause to go about, lead, conduct; यूथानि संचार्य <ls>Ś. 5. 5</ls>. .²2 To cause to spread, circulate. .²3 To transmit, communicate, pass over, deliver over to (as a disease <ab>&c.</ab>). .²4 To turn out (as cattle <ab>&c.</ab>) to graze. .²5 To impel, instigate, incite.
